metadata.name: Glycolysis / Gluconeogenesis (KEGG map00010)
metadata.description: Embden–Meyerhof–Parnas glycolysis and gluconeogenesis with the branches KEGG map00010 draws: glucose-1P, the 2,3-bisphosphoglycerate shunt, non-phosphorylating GAPN, pyruvate fates (lactate, ethanol, acetate, acetyl-CoA) and the bacterial PTS route of aryl-β-glucosides. Derived from KEGG; drawn by GEMsMAP.

scope.note: Core steps are conserved; G6Pase, PPDK/PPS, PDC/ADH, GAPN and the aryl-β-glucoside PTS route are organism-specific. Compartments are left unspecified (KEGG gives none): the matcher decides them in each GEM.

citations.text: Kanehisa M, Goto S. KEGG: Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes. Nucleic Acids Res 28:27-30 (2000)

source.generation_method: KEGG flat files + KGML (structure only) → curated biological graph → identities reconciled with MetaNetX (backend client) and the BiGG tables → hand-designed layout
